_source.description: Curated live underwater webcam streams from marine environments — reef cams and ocean floor cameras
_source.origin: YouTube Live streams from Coral City Camera (coralcitycamera.com), Deerfield Beach/Lower Florida Keys (Florida Fish and Wildlife), Utopia Village (utopiautila.com), Explore.org (explore.org/livecams)
_source.notes: YouTube IDs may change as streams rotate. Only includes streams with confirmed YouTube IDs. Aquarium cams (Monterey Bay, Georgia, National, Vancouver) use proprietary streaming — not YouTube — and are excluded.
